scope: Selected explicit scalar call prototypes on unchanged Darwin Mach-O code, plus shared Darwin 128-bit parameter placement. This is not whole-image or native Darwin unwinding qualification.
changes: Fixed analyst Darwin calls reuse the existing native scalar ABI owner.
LLVM calls use validated integer-register and result extension attributes, independently of source spelling.
Darwin 128-bit integer and aligned record register pairs can begin at odd registers. An exhausted 128-bit integer moves wholly to a 16-byte-aligned stack slot. ELF/COFF keep even register pairs.

excluded_runs: Initial narrow fixtures did not define the complete physical X0 return. Their model attempt failed; those results are not qualification.
Initial CTest label selection included stale sibling binaries because names share properties. That run was stopped and replaced by exact executable/CTest-index selection.

remaining: Automatic complete prototype and aggregate/HFA recovery and authenticated ABI transport.
128-bit analyst call prototypes and aggregate spills, beyond the corrected shared parameter placement.
Authenticated special-language calls, whole-image authenticated storage/binding/relocation and native Darwin signed exception unwinding.
Native Apple CPA2 execution and exact invalid-PAC fault PC/ESR equivalence.
